messages:
maya: FYI — hit a client report where requests that are "mixed-large" (big byte size + >dim threshold) just get a 413 from the edge with zero advice. customers are confused and SDKs just bubble the 413. We should consider an SDK/server pattern: adaptive client chunking + server advisory headers + console telemetry. :thinking:

aj: Totally. We already emit preflight info in some flows but it's not surfaced to clients. Idea: add a non-enforced advisory header on 413/400 responses: `X-Embed-Advice: dims=512,bytes=123456,units_est=3,reason=oversize` so client can auto-chunk. Keep it off for Dedicated by default unless tenant opts in.

kevin: For Dedicated tenants we can't silently change enforcement. They expect deterministic limits. If we add an advisory header we must ensure runtime doesn't leak quota policies across tenants. Suggest the header be scoped: `X-Embed-Advice-Tenant: yes/no` and only present when tenant policy allows.

maya: Agreed. Also want the console to show which tenants are seeing advisory headers vs hard failures. Right now we only track 413 counts. We need a telemetry signal for `embed.advice_sent` and `embed.advice_used` so product can measure SDK uptake.

sara: For rollout: 1) emit advisory header on hosted for 5% of traffic, 2) instrument `embed.advice_sent` tag=canary, 3) add a small dashboard tile in the Embed > SLOs page, 4) after 2 weeks bump to 25% if no regressions. Also provide an SDK opt-in flag `enable_advice_auto_chunking=true`.

tom: One operational concern: automatic chunking can increase request rate to backend (n small requests instead of 1 big) which affects burst capacity and quota metering. We need to reflect that in cost estimation and the units header. We should include `units_est` in the header so SDKs can surface cost tradeoffs to users.

aj: Simple header example I propose: `Embed-Estimate: dims=512,bytes=123456,units=4,split_suggestion=3x256` so SDK can choose split count. In code: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d @payload.json``` and server might return: ```HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
X-Embed-Advice: dims=512,bytes=123456,units_est=4,split=3x256
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"payload too large"}```

kevin: We should also include a `split_latency_est_ms` field in the advice so client can prefer splits that minimize wall time (e.g., 3 small parallel requests might be worse than 2 bigger sequential). Runtime can estimate based on recent p95 token latency.

maya: Love that. For console telemetry we need these metric names (proposal): `embed.preflight.advice_sent`, `embed.preflight.advice_accepted`, `embed.splitter.invocations`, `embed.splitter.avg_split_latency_ms`. Add tags: tenant, route, canary.

sara: I'll file a small Console ticket to add a tile and an alert: if `embed.preflight.advice_sent / embed.requests > 0.05` and `embed.preflight.advice_accepted < 0.1` for 7d, signal that clients aren't upgrading their SDKs. Also add an Ops alert if `splitter.invocations` spikes > 5x baseline.

tom: SDK design note: default should be conservative — surface a user-visible warning and let app decide. Only auto-chunk when `enable_advice_auto_chunking` set and when `units_est` x split_count < original_est_units * 1.2 to avoid cost explosions.

aj: Implementation checklist I can take: - add runtime advisory header (hosted only, tenant opt-in flag) - wire preflight estimator to response pipeline - emit `embed.preflight.advice_sent` metric - include `units_est` and `split_latency_est_ms` in advicepayload

kevin: I'll add guard rails for Dedicated: admin console toggle per-tenant and an audit log entry if advisory headers are enabled. Also enforce that advisory headers never include exact tenant quota numbers (just estimates).

maya: Can we add a tiny UX copy to the console so support agents can paste guidance to customers? e.g., "If you see 'payload too large', try splitting into N vectors of size M or upgrade plan." Keep it short.

console-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-EMBED-5632 — "Advisory header + SDK adaptive chunking canary". Linked to dashboard task CON-45. Assigned: aj, review: kevin, rollout: sara.

ingest-bot: Note: instrumentation spike risk — splitter creates more requests. Queue pressure metric to watch: `ingest.request_queue_depth` and `ingest.shed_rate`.

maya: Decision summary: 1) Emit advisory header in hosted as canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% if healthy. 2) Add `Embed-Estimate` fields: dims, bytes, units_est, split, split_latency_est_ms. 3) SDKs default to show warning; auto-chunk behind opt-in flag with cost guard. 4) Console tiles + alerts for adoption and operational spikes. 5) Dedicated: admin opt-in only, no quota leaks.

aj: I'll open the PR today with header format + unit metric. Expect review tomorrow. :shipit:

kevin: SGTM. Please include unit tests that verify header is not emitted for tenants with `advice=false`.

sara: I'll schedule the canary and add dashboards. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — will update customer-facing KB after canary results. Closing thread for now.
